name: ComNav MS-SAR5000 Ground-Based Slope Radar
summary: Radar berpresisi tinggi tipe Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar (GB-SAR) untuk pemantauan stabilitas lereng.
summaryEn: High-precision Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar (GB-SAR) engineered for continuous real-time slope stability monitoring.
specs: IP67 All-Weather (Kondisi Hujan, Kabut, Debu Tambang)
Panel Surya Hibrida + Baterai Industri Kontinu
specsEn: Radius up to 5,000 meters (5 km continuous coverage)
IP67 All-Weather (Rain, Dense Fog, Mining Dust)
Hybrid Solar Panel + Continuous Industrial Battery
Native direct integration with TerraPulse-AI platform

advantages.title: 0.1 mm Sub-Milimeter Detection
advantages.desc: Deteksi dini pergeseran mikroskopis lereng tambang sebelum retakan memicu longsoran fatal.
advantages.descEn: Early detection of microscopic slope creep before tension cracks trigger catastrophic failures.

advantages.title: 5.000m Continuous Range
advantages.desc: Cakupan area dinding batuan terbuka hingga 5 km dalam satu unit tanpa reflektor fisik.
advantages.descEn: Covers open rock pit faces up to 5 km in a single unit without physical prisms or targets.

advantages.title: < 2 Menit Rapid Scan Cycle
advantages.desc: Interferometri radar cepat memberikan pembaruan data deformasi mendekati real-time.
advantages.descEn: High-speed radar interferometry provides deformation updates in near real-time.

advantages.title: Integrasi Langsung TerraPulse-AI
advantages.desc: Sinkronisasi otomatis dengan monitoring center TerraWatch 24/7 dan sistem sirine peringatan dini.
advantages.descEn: Automatic synchronization with 24/7 TerraWatch monitoring center and site siren systems.

name: ComNav N2 Palm GNSS
nameEn: ComNav N2 Palm GNSS / Laser RTK Receiver
summary: Receiver GNSS saku ultra-ringan dengan modul laser EDM terintegrasi untuk pengukuran titik tersembunyi/berbahaya tanpa jangkauan jalon pole, dilengkapi kamera AR visual stakeout dan kompensasi tilt IMU hingga 60°.
summaryEn: Ultra-lightweight pocket GNSS receiver with integrated laser EDM for surveying hard-to-reach and hazardous points without pole placement, featuring HD AR visual stakeout camera and calibration-free IMU tilt compensation up to 60°.
specs: Pengukuran Jarak Laser Presisi Sub-Sentimeter Tanpa Pole
Kamera Visual HD untuk Panduan Stakeout Real-Time
IP68 Alloy Tahan Air & Jatuh 2 Meter
specsEn: Sub-Centimeter Precision Laser Distance Measurement Without Pole
Calibration-Free IMU up to 60° Tilt Angle
HD Visual Camera for Real-Time On-Screen Stakeout Guidance

advantages.title: Modul Laser EDM Terintegrasi
advantages.desc: Ukur titik tersembunyi, tebing curam, atau area bahaya tanpa harus menempatkan jalon pole.
advantages.descEn: Measure concealed points, steep cuttings, or hazardous zones without range pole placement.

advantages.title: Augmented Reality (AR) Stakeout
advantages.desc: Kamera HD menampilkan panduan navigasi stakeout langsung di layar secara visual.
advantages.descEn: HD camera displays live on-screen visual navigation arrows for effortless stakeout.

advantages.title: Ukuran Saku Ultra Ringan 170g
advantages.desc: Desain ultra ringkas seukuran genggaman tangan, nyaman digunakan sepanjang hari.
advantages.descEn: Ultra-compact palm-sized design ensures all-day fatigue-free field operation.

advantages.title: IMU 60° Bebas Kalibrasi
advantages.desc: Pengukuran tetap presisi walau pole miring tanpa interferensi medan magnetik.
advantages.descEn: Maintains accurate coordinates even at extreme pole tilt without magnetic disturbance.

name: ComNav T20 Multi-Constellation GNSS Receiver

summaryEn: Next-generation smart GNSS receiver featuring state-of-the-art satellite tracking technology, internal multi-protocol UHF radio, and 3rd-generation IMU for superior topographic and geodetic surveying efficiency.
specs: Horizontal: 8 mm + 1 ppm, Vertikal: 15 mm + 1 ppm
IMU 60° bebas kalibrasi tanpa terganggu medan magnet
Internal UHF 2W, Bluetooth, WiFi & 4G LTE Modem
Baterai ganda hot-swappable tahan kerja hingga 16 jam
specsEn: Horizontal: 8 mm + 1 ppm, Vertical: 15 mm + 1 ppm
60° IMU calibration-free and immune to magnetic disturbance
Internal 2W UHF, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi & 4G LTE Modem
Dual hot-swappable batteries with up to 16 hours of continuous operation

advantages.title: Baterai Hot-Swap Tahan Lama
advantages.desc: Pengoperasian tanpa henti hingga 16+ jam dengan sistem baterai ganda cerdas.
advantages.descEn: Non-stop field operation up to 16+ hours with intelligent dual hot-swap battery system.

advantages.title: 1.408 Kanal Pelacakan Lengkap
advantages.desc: Melacak seluruh konstelasi satelit (GPS, BDS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS) secara simultan.
advantages.descEn: Simultaneously tracks all constellations (GPS, BDS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS) for rock-solid RTK fixes.

advantages.title: IMU Generasi ke-3
advantages.desc: Kompensasi kemiringan hingga 60° bebas kalibrasi dengan akurasi 2.5 cm.
advantages.descEn: 60° tilt compensation with instant calibration-free readiness and 2.5 cm accuracy.

advantages.title: UHF Internal 2W Multi-Protokol
advantages.desc: Jarak jangkauan radio base-rover hingga 15 km dengan kompatibilitas protokol luas.
advantages.descEn: Base-to-rover radio link up to 15 km with wide industry protocol interoperability.

name: ComNav Mars Pro Laser RTK
summary: Receiver GNSS inovatif yang memadukan teknologi GNSS, modul laser, dan sensor IMU untuk mempermudah pengukuran di medan sulit tanpa jangkauan range pole konvensional. Dirancang untuk kebutuhan land survey, konstruksi, GIS, dan machine guidance dengan presisi tinggi.
summaryEn: An innovative GNSS receiver integrating GNSS positioning, laser EDM, and IMU sensors to simplify measurements in challenging terrain without conventional range poles. Engineered for high-precision land surveying, construction, GIS, and machine guidance.
specsEn: 3,400 mAh Battery with IP67 Rugged Ingress Protection

advantages.title: Laser EDM Milimeter
advantages.desc: Tembak titik di lereng terjal atau tebing tanpa membahayakan surveyor di lapangan.
advantages.descEn: Measure points on steep slopes or unsafe zones without risking surveyor safety.

advantages.title: Layar OLED Interaktif
advantages.desc: Pantau status satelit, baterai, dan mode kerja langsung di bodi instrumen.
advantages.descEn: Monitor satellite tracking, battery level, and modes directly on the instrument body.

advantages.title: 1.590 Kanal Multi-Satelit
advantages.desc: Pelacakan konstelasi penuh untuk fix yang sangat cepat dan konsisten.
advantages.descEn: Comprehensive constellation tracking delivering ultra-fast and consistent RTK locks.

advantages.title: Bodi Paduan Magnesium Ringan
advantages.desc: Standar industri IP67 yang tahan banting dan cuaca ekstrem lapangan.
advantages.descEn: IP67 certified all-weather durability engineered for tough fieldwork conditions.

name: ComNav Jupiter Laser RTK
summary: Jupiter Laser RTK adalah receiver GNSS kelas atas yang mengintegrasikan teknologi GNSS mutakhir, sensor IMU, laser, dan kamera ganda. Dilengkapi platform K8 terbaru dengan 1668 kanal untuk melacak semua konstelasi satelit, fitur visual stake-out, serta kompensasi kemiringan IMU hingga 60°/120°. Solusi ideal untuk pengukuran di area berbahaya, sulit dijangkau, atau bersinyal lemah dengan daya tahan baterai hingga 16+ jam.
summaryEn: The Jupiter Laser RTK is a flagship GNSS receiver combining cutting-edge GNSS technology, IMU sensors, laser EDM, and dual cameras. Powered by the latest K8 platform with 1,668 channels for tracking all satellite constellations, visual AR stakeout, and calibration-free IMU tilt compensation up to 60°/120°. An ideal solution for surveying in hazardous, obstructed, or weak-signal environments with 16+ hours of continuous battery life.
specs: GPS, BDS (BDS-2, BDS-3), GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, IRNSS, SBAS
specsEn: GPS, BDS (BDS-2, BDS-3), GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, IRNSS, SBAS
Up to 60° tilt with 2.5 cm accuracy (Calibration-free)

advantages.title: Visual AR Stakeout Kamera Ganda
advantages.desc: Navigasi stakeout visual imersif langsung membimbing surveyor ke titik sasaran presisi.
advantages.descEn: Immersive visual guidance directly leads surveyors to target points with sub-centimeter accuracy.

advantages.title: 1.668 Kanal K8 GNSS Engine
advantages.desc: Kapasitas komputasi satelit terdepan di industri untuk stabilitas sinyal tak tertandingi.
advantages.descEn: Industry-leading multi-satellite tracking engine for unmatched signal stability in dense cover.

advantages.title: Laser Jarak Jauh 50 Meter
advantages.desc: Pengukuran titik tanpa sentuh dan tanpa pole di area tebing berbahaya dan terhalang.
advantages.descEn: Contactless and poleless measurement in high-risk cliff faces and obstructed corners.

advantages.title: Daya Tahan Kerja 16+ Jam
advantages.desc: Baterai berkapasitas tinggi mendukung operasional survei seharian penuh tanpa jeda.
advantages.descEn: High-capacity power system enables full-day intensive surveying without interruptions.

name: ComNav LS600 Handheld 3D Laser Scanner
summary: LS600 adalah pemindai laser 3D (laser scanner) portabel yang mengintegrasikan teknologi SLAM mutakhir, modul RTK internal untuk akurasi sentimeter, serta kamera ganda untuk menghasilkan point cloud berwarna dengan detail tinggi. Menggunakan perpaduan multi-sensor (LiDAR, IMU, GNSS, dan kamera), perangkat ini menjamin performa stabil baik di dalam ruangan (indoor) maupun luar ruangan (outdoor). Desainnya ringkas dan ringan, sangat cocok untuk survei pemetaan, GIS, pertambangan, dan kehutanan.
summaryEn: The LS600 is a versatile handheld 3D laser scanner that integrates advanced SLAM, a built-in RTK module for ±1 cm accuracy, and dual cameras for generating rich color point clouds. With seamless multi-sensor fusion combining LiDAR, IMU, camera, and GNSS, it delivers superior, reliable performance across indoor and outdoor environments in a lightweight, rugged design. Ideal for surveying & mapping, GIS, mining, and forestry applications.
specs: Fusi Multi-Sensor (LiDAR, Real-Time SLAM, RTK, IMU, Kamera Ganda)
Fleksibel (Mendukung GNSS RTK & Titik Kontrol GCP)
specsEn: Multi-Sensor Fusion (LiDAR, Real-Time SLAM, RTK, IMU, Dual Cameras)
Flexible (RTK Coordinates & One-Tap Control Point Optimization)

advantages.title: Real-Time SLAM & GNSS RTK
advantages.desc: Kombinasi SLAM dan modul RTK internal menghasilkan point cloud absolut bergeoreferensi langsung di lokasi.
advantages.descEn: Integrates real-time SLAM with an internal RTK module for directly georeferenced absolute point clouds.

advantages.title: Kamera Ganda Point Cloud Berwarna
advantages.titleEn: Dual Cameras for True Color Clouds
advantages.desc: Kamera fotogrametri ganda menangkap warna realistis untuk visualisasi 3D yang hidup.
advantages.descEn: Dual high-resolution cameras capture lifelike true-color textures for vivid 3D deliverables.

advantages.title: Desain Ringkas & Multi-Mode
advantages.desc: Bisa digunakan mode genggam (handheld), dipasang pada tiang ekstensi, atau ransel survei (backpack).
advantages.descEn: Easily deployed as a handheld unit, on an extension pole, or in a mobile backpack kit.

advantages.title: Performa Indoor & Outdoor
advantages.desc: Stabil beroperasi di dalam terowongan, bangunan, maupun hutan lebat tanpa ketergantungan satelit.
advantages.descEn: Seamlessly operates in tunnels, building interiors, and dense forest canopies without satellite dependency.
